source.title: BP PODCAST #20: don Tomislav Lukač i Timon Pavlić: Crkva & TikTok - kako pristupiti mladima?

summary.title_hr: BP PODCAST #20: don Tomislav Lukač i Timon Pavlić: Crkva & TikTok - kako pristupiti mladima?
summary.abstract_hr: U ovoj epizodi BP podcasta, don Tomislav Lukač i Timon Pavlić razgovaraju o izazovima i načinima pristupa mladima u Crkvi. Gosti dijele svoja osobna svjedočanstva o vjeri i mladosti, te analiziraju zašto se mladi udaljavaju od Crkve i kako im se može pomoći da pronađu svoje mjesto u vjeri. Naglašava se važnost autentičnog svjedočanstva, suradnje klera i laika, te razumijevanja suvremenih problema mladih, uključujući ulogu društvenih mreža u evangelizaciji.
key_topics: uloga obitelji i Crkve u odgoju
key_points: Mladi se često udaljavaju od Crkve zbog krive slike o Bogu i Crkvi, doživljavajući je kao instituciju koja zabranjuje i ne razumije njihove potrebe.
Odgovornost za odgoj mladih leži prvenstveno na roditeljima, ali i na Crkvi koja treba koristiti nove alate i pristupe, uključujući društvene mreže i svjedočanstva starijih mladih.
Don Boscov odgojni sustav naglašava vjeru, razum i ljubaznost, te pronalaženje 'točke dobrote' u svakoj mladoj osobi kao poluge za cjelovit odgoj.
Suradnja svećenika i laika je ključna, jer laici mogu mladima prenijeti vjeru na autentičan način, svjedočeći vlastitim iskustvom.
Aktivnosti poput kampova i oratorija privlače mlade, uključujući i one izvan Crkve, nudeći im zajedništvo i prostor za druženje.
Najveći problemi mladih danas uključuju razmaženost, manjak koncentracije, nisko samopouzdanje, samoozljeđivanje i suicidalne misli, uz izazove hiperseksualnosti i čistoće.
Važno je ne odustajati od mladih, pružati im prilike za susret s vjerom i svjedocima, te ih poticati na aktivno sudjelovanje u župnim zajednicama.
summary.title_en: BP PODCAST #20: don Tomislav Lukač and Timon Pavlić: Church & TikTok - how to approach young people?
summary.abstract_en: In this episode of the BP podcast, don Tomislav Lukač and Timon Pavlić talk about the challenges and ways of approaching young people in the Church. The guests share their personal testimonies about faith and youth, and analyze why young people distance themselves from the Church and how they can be helped to find their place in the faith. The importance of authentic testimony, cooperation between clergy and laity, and understanding the contemporary problems of young people, including the role of social networks in evangelization, is emphasized.
key_topics_en: relationship between young people and the Church
challenges of faith among young people
the role of the family and the Church in upbringing
key_points_en: Young people often distance themselves from the Church because of a wrong image of God and the Church, perceiving it as an institution that forbids and does not understand their needs.

The responsibility for the upbringing of young people lies primarily on parents, but also on the Church, which needs to use new tools and approaches, including social networks and testimonies of older youth.
Don Bosco's educational system emphasizes faith, reason, and kindness, and finding the 'point of goodness' in every young person as a lever for integral education.
Cooperation of priests and laypeople is crucial, because laypeople can transmit the faith to the youth in an authentic way, witnessing with their own experience.
Activities such as camps and oratories attract young people, including even those outside the Church, offering them fellowship and space for socializing.
The greatest problems of young people today include spoiledness, lack of concentration, low self-confidence, self-harm, and suicidal thoughts, along with the challenges of hypersexuality and purity.
It is important not to give up on young people, to provide them with opportunities for an encounter with faith and witnesses, and to encourage them to active participation in parish communities.
